data.name: Methuselah
data.gender_notes: Methuselah is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: According to the Hebrew Bible, Methuselah is the oldest known human in history, with a lifespan of 969 years. His name is derived from the Hebrew words methus elah, meaning 'man of the ground' or 'man of the soil'. The name Methuselah carries the meaning “Man of the ground” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Methuselah usually hope their child will grow to embody man of the ground and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes long life, connection to the earth, and divine grace.
data.etymology: Methuselah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of the ground.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Methuselah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: מתושלח
in_hebrew.meaning: איש אשר שולח מות או שמחת אל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מתושלח הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'איש אשר שולח מות' או 'שמחת אל', ומתייחס לאדם שהביא בשורה טובה או שהיה שליח של אלוהים. השם מורכב מ'מת' שפירושו 'מות' ו'שלח' שפירושו 'שולח'. מתושלח היה בנו של אנוך ואביו של למך, והוא מוזכר בספר בראשית כמי שחי 969 שנים, תקופה ארוכה מאוד.

in_greek.name: Μαθουσαλα
in_greek.meaning: Άνθρωπος του Θεού ή άνθρωπος της αποστολής
in_greek.long_meaning: Μαθουσαλα είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος מתושלח (Methuselah), που σημαίνει 'άνθρωπος του Θεού' ή 'άνθρωπος της αποστολής'. Ο Μαθουσαλας ήταν ένας από τους πατριαρχές της Βίβλου, γνωστός για την μεγάλη του ηλικία και τη σύνδεσή του με τον πατέρα του, τον Ενώχ, που ήταν ένας από τους πιο σημαντικούς προσώπων στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Methuselah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Methuselah, e hebraeo گرفته, significat 'Homo Dei' vel 'homo emissarius'. In Scriptura, Methuselah fuit filius Enochi et pater Lamech, et notus est propter longam vitam suam, nam vixit annos 969. Hoc nomen habet magnam significationem in traditione christiana, scilicet vitam longam et sapientiam.

in_english.name: Methuselah
in_english.meaning: Man of dart or his death shall bring
in_english.long_meaning: The name Methuselah originates from the Hebrew name מתושלח (Methuselah), which means 'man of dart' or 'his death shall bring'. In the biblical context, Methuselah was the son of Enoch and the father of Lamech, known for living an exceptionally long life of 969 years, as recorded in the book of Genesis. The name carries significant spiritual meaning, symbolizing longevity, wisdom, and a connection to divine providence. Throughout Christian tradition, Methuselah is regarded as a symbol of endurance and faith.

As the oldest known human, Methuselah holds the record for the longest human lifespan ever recorded. This has fascinated scholars, artists, and thinkers throughout history, leading to numerous depictions of Methuselah in literature, art, and music. From longer life spans in folktales to scientific theories about aging and immortality, the cultural impact of Methuselah's name continues to inspire curiosity and intrigue.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Methuselah's name can serve as a reminder of God's power and sovereignty over all aspects of creation, including the human lifespan. As the longest-lived human in history, Methuselah's life span can also be viewed as a symbol of God's faithfulness and mercy, extending human life beyond the normal bounds. In this sense, Methuselah's name can inspire awe, gratitude, and a deeper appreciation for the mysteries of God's creation and the divine plan for humanity. Additionally, Methuselah's extraordinary longevity can serve as a reminder of the inherent worth and dignity of every human life, regardless of age or stage in life. Overall, the name Methuselah carries rich spiritual significance, reminding us of God's power, mercy, and the inherent worth of every human life.
